credentials.description: client_id of the environment (sandbox: developer account dashboard; production: Settings → API Keys, v4)

example_prompt: List my Flutterwave settlements for a date range to reconcile collected payments with what reached my bank or wallet.

page.description: Query parameter. The page of the data to retrieve. The most recent data entry is on page 1.

size.description: Query parameter. Length of data returned. Defaults to 10.

to.description: Query parameter. The end date and time for a period. This parameter is used in conjunction with the 'from' parameter to define a time range. The value should be in **ISO 8601 format**.

from.description: Query parameter. The start date and time for a period. This parameter is used in conjunction with the 'to' parameter to define a time range. The value should be in ISO 8601 format.

total.description: The total number of items available across all pages

current_page.description: The current page number being viewed

total_pages.description: The total number of pages required to display all items.

items.description: A settlement of a successful transaction

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. The API's currency enum has 163 codes and uses SLL for Sierra Leone, not SLE.

transaction_datetime.description: The date the transaction was created.

settlement_account.description: The bank account number to which the transaction was settled.

type.description: The type of fee charged on the transaction.

charge_count.description: The number of charge transactions that make up the settlement.

created_datetime.description: The date and time when the virtual account was created.

message.description: Present on 401/403/409 bodies; the 400 body has none.

type.description: Error category. Generic: REQUEST_NOT_VALID, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, RESOURCE_CONFLICT, UNPROCESSABLE, INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR; or a domain type (see code).

code.description: String. Generic 10400/10401/10403/10404/10409/10422/10500, or a domain code documented for this endpoint: 1500404 SETTLEMENT_NOT_FOUND.

gotchas: Auth: one token server for both environments — the docs' Multi-Environment Integrations example sends either environment's credentials to https://idp.flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token, and Authentication says "This process applies to both the sandbox and production environments. Make sure to use the correct credentials for each environment to obtain a valid token." "Each token is valid for **10 minutes**"; "We recommend refreshing the token at least one minute before it expires." Cache the token. Sandbox: "We archive your test data after 30 days."

Headers: X-Trace-Id is optional on this GET (the headers guide lists it under 'Optional API Headers'; "It must be a string using only alphanumeric ASCII characters.", 12-255 characters). The API reference documents no X-Idempotency-Key for this endpoint.
Docs (Settlements): "Only transactions made in **live/production** mode are eligible for settlement." Expect no settlements in sandbox.

A settlement moves collected funds to your bank account or "Your **Flutterwave for Business (F4B) wallet** (payout balance)." See data[].destination; amounts are gross_amount / net_amount with a fees[] breakdown; charge_count is a string.
The guide's prose shows "`status`: The current status of the settlement (e.g., SUCCESSFUL, PENDING)." but the API returns the lowercase enum (e.g. 'completed').

Pagination: page ≥ 1 (default 1, most recent first), size 10-50 (default 10); read meta.page_info.total_pages. The API reference caps some list responses at 10 items (maxItems 10) although size goes up to 50: always paginate. from / to are ISO 8601 date-times.

Errors: {"status":"failed","error":{"type","code","message","validation_errors"}}; error.code is a string and 400s carry validation_errors[{field_name,message}]. Besides the generic codes (10400 REQUEST_NOT_VALID, 10401, 10403 FORBIDDEN, 10404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, 10409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT, 10422 UNPROCESSABLE, 10500) the error table documents these for this endpoint: 1500404 SETTLEMENT_NOT_FOUND. Branch on error.type / error.code, not on the HTTP status alone. Docs (Errors): "The current limit is 500 API requests per minute." A 429 can come back as a non-JSON page ("HTML error pages such as `Cloudflare 1015 responses`"): parse error bodies defensively and back off exponentially with jitter.
open_questions: Token URL: the PHP sample of Authentication uses https://keycloak.dev-flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token; its curl and JavaScript samples and the Multi-Environment example use https://idp.flutterwave.com/realms/flutterwave/protocol/openid-connect/token, which this spec follows.
